judge_reasoning: The model solution follows essentially the same line as the official solution: Shock the Ballista to cap its safe future activations at 2 damage (via the marked-damage/counter-removal interaction), then use Saheeli's -2 twice (on Fireweaver, then Whirler Virtuoso after Felidar Guardian blinks Saheeli) to generate artifact-entry triggers for Reckless Fireweaver, followed by a Thopter creation for one more trigger, then attacking for exactly lethal damage. The model correctly adds the necessary Island land drop (needed for mana that the official solution omits mentioning but requires), correctly reasons through why the opponent's Ballista cannot kill any required permanent (all have 3+ toughness vs. max 2 safe damage), and properly handles the edge case where the opponent aggressively drains the Ballista in response to Shock (pivoting to the guaranteed infinite combo since Saheeli survives at 5 loyalty). The math checks out exactly matching the official solution's tally of exactly 10 damage dealt through non-combat triggers (6) and combat (4).
model_solution:
1. Play Island.
2. Cast Shock (Spirebluff Canal) targeting Walking Ballista. 
   – If the opponent responds by removing 2+ counters, the Ballista dies (Shock finishes it or it's 0/0). Saheeli survives in every case (5 loyalty vs. at most 4 pings). Then cast Felidar Guardian, blink Saheeli (back at 3 loyalty), −2 copying Felidar; each copy blinks Saheeli for a fresh −2 with no Ballista left to interrupt → infinite artifact Felidar copies = infinite Fireweaver damage (or, if they killed Fireweaver, infinite hasty 1/4 attackers against a lone Constrictor). Win.
   – Main line: they don't respond. Ballista is a 4/4 with 2 damage: it can ping at most twice more before dying.
3. Saheeli Rai −2 targeting Reckless Fireweaver. The token copy is an artifact; the original Fireweaver and the copy both trigger → opponent to 8. (Two pings can't kill Fireweaver to fizzle this, and can't kill Saheeli at 3; if they ping Saheeli down, the Ballista dies and step 4 leads into the infinite loop instead.)
4. Cast Felidar Guardian (Needle Spires for W, Needle Spires, Spirebluff Canal, Island). ETB: exile Saheeli Rai and return her – she's a new object with 3 loyalty and can activate again. (Pings on Saheeli in response don't matter; she's blinked anyway, and if the Ballista has died, just −2 on Felidar for the infinite loop.)
5. Saheeli Rai −2 targeting Whirler Virtuoso. The Whirler copy (artifact) enters → 2 Fireweaver triggers → opponent to 6. Its ETB gives EEE; pay EEE for a Thopter → 2 more triggers → opponent to 4. (Two pings can't kill Whirler to fizzle the copy, nor either Fireweaver.)
6. Attack with Spell Queller (2, flying), Reckless Fireweaver (1), the Fireweaver copy (1, haste), Whirler Virtuoso (2) and the Whirler copy (2, haste) – 8 power. Neither Ballista nor Constrictor can block the flyer, and two blockers stop at most 2+2 = 4 power, so at least 4 damage gets through. Every attacker has 3 toughness, so the Ballista's ≤2 remaining pings can't kill anything. Opponent goes from 4 to 0 (or lower) – lethal against any blocks and any Ballista usage.
